classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design 1–2 binder candidates against a provided target structure using RFdiffusion backbone generation (2 seed-shards), ProteinMPNN sequence design, Boltz2 affinity prediction, lightweight sequence and backbone QC, and deterministic ranking.
assumptions: Target receptor occupies chain A; RFdiffusion places the binder on chain B.
Binder length defaults to 70–100 residues; override via params if a tighter range is known.
Two independent RFdiffusion seeds (42 and 43) each produce one backbone shard, yielding at most two ranked candidates — consistent with the tool's recommended_shard_size of 1.
ProteinMPNN designs 2 sequences per backbone at temperature 0.1; sequences[0] (highest log-likelihood) per backbone advances to affinity scoring.
Boltz2 affinity is run without MSA for speed; scores are calibrated but require experimental confirmation before advancing to synthesis.
No hotspot residues are provided; RFdiffusion diffuses over the full target surface. Hotspots can be injected into rfd_1/rfd_2 target_hotspots after target interface inspection.
protein_qc pLDDT is sourced from the RFdiffusion backbone PDB; sequence-based metrics (polybasic, GRAVY, instability_index, pI) use the top ProteinMPNN sequence for that backbone.
submit_candidate is excluded from this plan; final selection is a post-round decision made after ranking outputs are available.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: absolute path to the target receptor PDB file (required for rfdiffusion and protein_qc backbone pLDDT)
target_sequence: full single-letter amino-acid sequence of target chain A (required for boltz2_affinity inline sequences input)

success_criteria.backbone_shards: rfd_1 and rfd_2 each complete and emit one backbone PDB (seeds 42 and 43)
success_criteria.sequences_per_backbone: mpnn_1 and mpnn_2 each emit 2 candidate sequences; sequences[0] per backbone proceeds to affinity scoring
success_criteria.affinity_scored: affinity_1 and affinity_2 each return a calibrated Boltz2 affinity score for the top-1 binder sequence
success_criteria.qc_emitted: qc_1 and qc_2 each emit plddt, polybasic, gravy, instability_index, and pI scalars
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs returns a deterministic top-2 list combining affinity predictions, QC scalars, and backbone confidence
